name: Red One LLC

nadir.desc: The property consists of a large multi-section building with a complex dark gray roof|An in-ground swimming pool and spa are located adjacent to the main structure|A large paved parking and circulation area holds multiple vehicles and trailers|A detached building is present near the paved area|Extensive landscaping with trees, shrubs, and dryland plantings surrounds the site|Green lawn areas and a long paved driveway provide access from the street.

alpha.desc: The front of the property shows a large stone and stucco-style building with a complex dark gray roof|A long paved driveway leads from the street into a large parking area|An in-ground swimming pool is visible near the main structure|From this view, the structure sits above the road with a long set of stairs going from the road to the front of the structure|Multiple vehicles and trailers are parked in the paved area|A detached building is present|Extensive landscaping and fencing enclose the property.

bravo.desc: The left side of the property shows the side of the main building, the swimming pool, and the large paved parking area|Multiple vehicles and trailers are present|A detached building sits near the parking area|Landscaping with trees and shrubs extends along the perimeter|Fencing encloses the lot.

charlie.desc: The rear of the property shows the back of the large multi-section building|A green lawn area is present near the structure|The paved parking area, detached outbuilding, and portions of the swimming pool are visible|Extensive landscaping and fencing continue around the perimeter of the lot.

delta.desc: The right side of the property shows the side and rear of the main building|Green lawn and  landscaping are visible|Fencing and dryland plantings enclose the outer edges of the property|A combination of sidewalk and paths are visible on this side of the structure.

considerations: Vehicle access is provided by a long paved driveway that leads from the street to the left of the structure into a parking and circulation area capable of holding multiple vehicles and trailers. The main building is a large multi-section structure with a complex roofline. An in-ground swimming pool and spa are located adjacent to the building. A small detached outbuilding is present near the parking area. Extensive landscaping and fencing surround the property. The site is located in a hillside residential area adjacent to open fields and park land, with neighboring homes on larger lots.
clarifications: Where is the primary entrance into the main building, and is it accessible from the paved parking area? Are there designated fire lanes or emergency vehicle staging zones within the large paved area? Is the detached outbuilding used for vehicle storage, equipment, or other purposes? Does the fencing fully enclose the property with controlled gates, or are there open access points? Is vehicle access available around all sides of the main building, or is movement limited by landscaping and grade changes?
